name: lensy-packages
description: Workspace root for the Lensy CLI (@perseverance-ai/lensy) and its engine API (@perseverance-ai/lensy-core).

scripts.build: npm run build -w core && npm run build -w cli
scripts.check:secrets: gitleaks dir --no-banner --redact . && gitleaks dir --no-banner --redact core/dist && gitleaks dir --no-banner --redact cli/dist
